title: Database Normalization Fundamentals
summary: This content introduces database normalization, a process to organize data for reduced duplication and improved integrity. It defines functional dependency and outlines the requirements for First, Second, and Third Normal Forms, each addressing specific types of dependencies.

topics.title: Database Normalization Overview
topics.notes: Organizes data to reduce duplication and improve data integrity.

topics.title: Functional Dependency
topics.notes: Occurs when one attribute determines another attribute.

topics.title: First Normal Form (1NF)
topics.notes: Requires atomic values and no repeating groups.
